tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and panel background: the popup, side panel, settings and backup pages.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Recessed surfaces: hovered list rows, the search field's resting fill, secondary panels.

tokens.name: paper-3
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected neutral surfaces, the favicon tile behind a page's initial.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and the bold outlines of buttons, inputs, tabs and tags, on paper, paper-2 and paper-3 (12:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: page domains, dates, counts, helper text. Readable on paper, paper-2 and paper-3 (5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between list rows and settings groups, and quiet structure where a bold ink outline would be too loud. Never for control borders.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring color (see the focus-ring shadow). 4.9:1 or better on paper and paper-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in running text, on paper, paper-2 and paper-3.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive labels on paper, paper-2 and paper-3.

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of destructive buttons (Delete all notes), always with note-ink text, in both themes.

tokens.name: sticker-shadow
tokens.usage: The color of the hard offset shadow under sticker-style controls (used inside the sticker shadows).

tokens.name: hl-yellow
tokens.usage: Highlighter yellow: the primary action fill, the selected tab, the signature highlighter swipe, and yellow highlights and tags. Text on it is note-ink. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: hl-pink
tokens.usage: Highlighter pink for highlights and tags. Text on it is note-ink.

tokens.name: hl-blue
tokens.usage: Highlighter blue for highlights and tags. Text on it is note-ink.

tokens.name: hl-green
tokens.usage: Highlighter green for highlights and tags. Text on it is note-ink.

tokens.name: hl-orange
tokens.usage: Highlighter orange for highlights and tags. Text on it is note-ink.

tokens.name: hl-purple
tokens.usage: Highlighter purple for highlights and tags. Text on it is note-ink.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary action per view (New note, Download backup). Text on it is on-primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary, highlighter fills and danger-fill, in both themes (8:1 or better).

tokens.name: swipe-yellow
tokens.usage: The highlighter swipe behind title words (dm-swipe), yellow. Deeper in the dark theme so ink text on it stays readable (5:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: swipe-blue
tokens.usage: The highlighter swipe, blue, when yellow would clash with something nearby.

tokens.name: swipe-pink
tokens.usage: The highlighter swipe, pink.

tokens.name: swipe-green
tokens.usage: The highlighter swipe, green.

tokens.name: note-yellow
tokens.usage: Sticky note fill, yellow (the default). Bright in both themes; text on it is note-ink.

tokens.name: note-pink
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper, pink. Text on it is note-ink.

tokens.name: note-blue
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper, blue. Text on it is note-ink.

tokens.name: note-green
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper, green. Text on it is note-ink.

tokens.name: note-orange
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper, orange. Text on it is note-ink.

tokens.name: note-purple
tokens.usage: Sticky note paper, purple. Text on it is note-ink.

tokens.name: note-ink
tokens.usage: Text and outlines on sticky notes and highlighter fills, in both themes (12:1 or better on every note color).

tokens.name: note-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on sticky notes: the date, the page a note came from (6:1 or better on every note color).

tokens.name: note-edge
tokens.usage: The hairline edge of a sticky note, on every note color, in both themes. Defines the note without a heavy outline.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque: modern with quirky details. Titles only, set tight.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One page title per screen: onboarding, the backup page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: View titles in the popup and side panel.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree for everything else, including the text people write in notes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your notes stay on this computer.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels and page titles in lists.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata under list titles, helper text.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Use the steps, never values in between.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between tags, between a list title and its metadata.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside notes and inputs, between list rows' content and their edges.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: View padding in the popup and side panel, between related groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Notebook rule pitch, and large separations on full pages.

radius.note: Soft and modern; pills for tags, tabs and the highlighter swipe.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small icon buttons and favicon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus and sticky notes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and cards on full pages.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags and segmented tabs.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows make controls feel like stickers; soft ones are for notes floating over web pages.

tokens.name: sticker
tokens.usage: Buttons and tabs on hover, menus and popovers.

tokens.name: sticker-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and tags at rest.

tokens.name: note-lift
tokens.usage: Sticky notes at rest on web pages, so they read above any site.

tokens.name: note-lift-hover
tokens.usage: Sticky notes while hovered or dragged: picked up off the page.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a paper-colored gap, then a solid focus ring.

stroke.note: Bold ink outlines for controls you press; hairlines for notes and quiet structure.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: Outlines of buttons, inputs, tabs and tags.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Sticky note edges and dividers.
